pages.title: Collecting the Inscription
pages.text: While wearing Spirit Glasses, right-click an Ancient Stele with an empty Reflection Orb. Collection cannot begin without the glasses, if the orb is already filled, or while the stele is busy.

pages.title: Rune Capacity
pages.text: A filled orb carries $(bold)100 runes$(). The orb has 5 durability; every completed extraction at a Rune Table consumes 1 durability, and the orb disappears when all five uses are spent.
